name: Nova
tagline: Ready-made website for creative and marketing agencies
description: Nova is a website template for creative and marketing agencies, with services, selected work, a team section and contact. Editorial typography, large imagery and ready-made sections give the site a distinctive visual direction. Replace the copy, photos and logo with your own before publishing.
features: Hero section with a clear call to action
Logo cloud for client or partner logos
Statistics section showing experience and scale
Selected work section for projects and case studies
Client reviews, to be replaced with genuine feedback
Content in JSON with documented sections, ready for AI coding tools
